# Decision - End the Ridgeway hauling contract

## Context

Ridgeway Freight carried bins between Main Street, Pinecrest, and Millbrook under a contract that renewed each January. The county van covered the other two branches. The [[Thistle Run|courier consolidation]] proposal put all five branches on network-owned vans.

## Decision

Give Ridgeway the required ninety days' notice and end the contract on December 31, 2025. Withdraw from the county van arrangement on the same date.

## Costs

Two used vans cost 61,000 dollars from the capital fund. Drivers, fuel, and insurance run about 74,000 dollars a year, compared with 88,000 dollars for Ridgeway and the county share in 2025. No Saturday run is budgeted.

## Risks

If a van breaks down there is no backup. [[Jory Petrakis]] arranged a short-term rental agreement with a dealer in Alder Falls.
